policy: Suggestive counts of identified species, independently selected for each ontology node and each extinction category from high-quality reference taxonomies. Closest reference taxa and proxies are explicit. Extinct and extant sources need not agree or add up, and counts never roll up through ontology children. No composite counts are assembled for paraphyletic groups. Omit unavailable counts; a known unsplit total has no status glyph. At most three significant digits with K/M, retaining significant trailing zeros. ☠︎ means catalogued extinct species; ♥︎ means extant or source-reported non-fossil/living-tree proxy, always last. Text presentation keeps the symbols monochrome.

col.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.9 base release
col.notes: Direct speciesExtantCount from reference-taxon metrics in COL26.9 Base. These publisher metrics include accepted and provisionally accepted species; sparse individual extinction flags are not used to discard the living count.

mdd.title: ASM Mammal Diversity Database v2.5
mdd.notes: 6904 species: 113 recently extinct and 6791 extant, including 17 domestic species. Species concepts differ from other checklists.

reptile.title: Reptile Database species statistics
reptile.notes: 12650 recognized non-avian reptile species, including one tuatara. This headline does not supply extinction status for every species.

ictv.title: ICTV Master Species List 41
ictv.notes: 17554 recognized species; the species worksheet contains 40 Pospiviroidae and 5 Avsunviroidae viroids.

amphibiaweb.title: AmphibiaWeb live species counter
amphibiaweb.notes: 9136 species: 8055 frogs, 846 salamanders and 235 caecilians; headline does not split extinct and extant.

pbdb.title: Paleobiology Database
pbdb.notes: Live API reference-subtree counts: accepted species, extant=no, pres=regular, rowcount=yes. Fossil coverage and classification are incomplete; these are catalogued species, not all species that ever lived.

onezoom.title: OneZoom living tree
onezoom.notes: Direct species counts on named-clade text pages. Main-tree coverage reflects its Open Tree of Life snapshot and includes some recently extinct leaves; use as a suggestive living-species reference, not a completeness claim.

wfo.title: World Flora Online
wfo.notes: 382401 accepted land-plant species; living/non-fossil checklist proxy.

worldplants.title: World Plants v26.08
worldplants.notes: Direct published group statistics; gymnosperms 1194 non-fossil species, with the reference’s acceptance policy.

iucn.title: IUCN Red List 2026-1, Table 1a
iucn.notes: Use the estimated described-species column and source-reported subtotals, never evaluated or threatened counts. Non-fossil estimates can retain recently extinct species.
